title: Restart recovery, message delivery and lease fencing
objective: Complete four arithmetic transactions through the cluster, communicating as you go: publish the shared total key `{{runId}}/total` on the blackboard after the last transaction is accepted, and send one message across subtrees to the second worker. The runner will restart the host process in the middle of the run; the cluster must resume from durable state without redoing an already committed result or charging a request twice.

recovery.note: The fault trigger is a *held model request*, not a wall-clock guess: the mock holds the Auditor's validation review of r4 open, and the runner kills the host while that identity is genuinely mid-turn. r4 is made dependent on r3 first, so the fixture message that crosses subtrees is already delivered and the receiving Worker has already submitted. This does not claim to hit the internal flush→ACK micro-window; that invariant is proven by the precise persistence-injection tests, and the native report says so.

acceptance_criteria: The submitted result contains the number 10
